items.caption:
Can a dreamer answer your question?
In a 2021 study across 4 labs, some lucid dreamers (people who know they are dreaming) in lab-verified REM sleep answered simple questions with eye movements or facial-muscle signals. Only about 18% of 158 tries got a correct answer, most got none: it is rare and hard.
